BlueprintConfiguration.description: A configuration or overlay. Section keys are structural, not input references.

InputDefinition.description: A small JSON Schema vocabulary; defaults are values, never expressions.
InputDefinition.title: InputDefinition

anyOf.description:
Parameters. Omitted tag parameters leave local tags unchanged (``[]`` clears them); an omitted
``redundant_streams`` preserves the SIPS mode (``true`` → ``SIPSAuto``, ``false`` → ``NONE``).
anyOf.title: MatroxConvertIPParams

matrox.convertip.default.TagDelta.description:
Additive tag change that preserves unrelated local tags. Tag references are exact catalog
tag ids (for example ``Format~~V_1080p50``); the engine never creates catalog entries.
matrox.convertip.default.TagDelta.title: TagDelta

description:
A reusable configuration with typed inputs and ordered variant overlays.

Load with :meth:`load` (file), :meth:`from_yaml` (text/bytes), or :meth:`from_dict` (mapping).
Loading never connects to a server. Variants patch ``defaults`` in caller-selected order.
